display_name: Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI Models: Safety and Security Chapter
citation: Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI Models, Safety and Security Chapter
instrument_kind: voluntary code of practice: binds only its Signatories; the Code describes itself as 'a guiding document for demonstrating compliance with the obligations provided for in Articles 53 and 55 AI Act' (Objectives, point A, p. 2)
authority: Published by the European Commission (served from the DG CONNECT newsroom). The text's title page names the Chairs and Vice-Chairs of Working Groups 2, 3 and 4 and no other author.

related_subjects.eu/ai-act-2024: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the AI Act), which the Code refers to throughout. Encoded separately; this subject does not import it. Links are in the encoding's NOTES.md.

source.versions: One. The PDF's text states no date, version or version history; the subject slug's year (2025) rests on the PDF's metadata, not its text. See registers/source-bundle/cop-safety-security-2025.meta.json.
